newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - SECHABA LEADS BUSIER TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - SECHABA LEADS BUSIER TRADE.

text.p: holding company Sechaba caused a sharp increase in activity on
the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE) last week.
Rising were Sechaba, up five thebe to 250 thebe, and
Barclays, up two thebe to 460 thebe.
Trading unchanged were First National and milling company
and food wholesaler Sefalana. Losing value was food and tobacco
wholesaler Metsef, shedding five thebe to 625 thebe.
Untraded were Botswana Insurance, oil company Engen,
security group Inco, investment company Kgolo ya Sechaba,
clothing chain Pep, variable loan stock company RDC Properties
Turnover and value was well up, with 149,775 (17,325) shares
The index gained 2.56 points to close at 353.43.
